session_info:
20th City Council
16th Regular Session
Series of 2026
committee: Committee on Finance, Ways and Means and Appropriations and Committee on Disaster Risk Reduction and Management
title: AN ORDINANCE APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE AMENDMENT AND UTILIZATION OF THE CALENDAR YEAR 2026 LOCAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT FUND INVESTMENT PLAN (LDRRMFIP) AND QUICK RESPONSE FUND (QRF) OF THE CITY DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT OFFICE (CDRRMO) IN THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF FIFTEEN MILLION PESOS (P15,000,000.00)
enacting_clause: Be it ordained by the Honorable Sangguniang Panlungsod of Davao City in session assembled, that:

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be known as "AN ORDINANCE APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE AMENDMENT AND UTILIZATION OF THE CALENDAR YEAR 2026 LOCAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT FUND INVESTMENT PLAN (LDRRMFIP) AND QUICK RESPONSE FUND (QRF) OF THE CITY DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT OFFICE (CDRRMO) IN THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF FIFTEEN MILLION PESOS (P15,000,000.00)".
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Standard ordinance title clause modeled after Ord. No. 0692-21 and Ord. No. 0598-24.

sections.sec_title: DECLARATION OF POLICY AND LEGAL BASIS
sections.text:
Section 324 (d) of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended, and Section 21 of Republic Act No. 10121, otherwise known as the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010, provide that not less than five percent (5%) of the estimated revenue from regular sources shall be set aside as the Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund (LDRRMF) to support disaster risk management activities.

Of the amount appropriated for the LDRRMF, thirty percent (30%) shall be allocated as a Quick Response Fund (QRF) or stand-by fund for relief and recovery programs in order that the situation and living conditions of people in communities or areas stricken by disasters, calamities, epidemics, or complex emergencies may be normalized as quickly as possible.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 10121 §21; Republic Act No. 7160 §324(d)
sections.legal_rationale: Accurately states the statutory mandate governing the 5% LDRRMF and 30% Quick Response Fund under RA 10121 §21.

sections.sec_title: AMENDMENT AND SCHEDULE OF FUND UTILIZATION
sections.text:
The Davao City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund Investment Plan (DCDRRMFIP) for Calendar Year 2026 is hereby amended to fund urgent flood relief and rehabilitation operations in Paquibato and Marilog Districts as follows:

| Budget Item / Program Description | Source Allocation | Appropriated Amount (Php) |
|---|---|---|
| FROM: Unprogrammed Disaster Mitigation Equipment Reserve | 70% Mitigation Fund | P 15,000,000.00 |
| TO: 1. Procurement of Modular Family Evacuation Tents and Hygiene Kits for Paquibato District |LDRRMF Relief | P 4,500,000.00 |
| TO: 2. Deployment of Mobile Potable Water Filtration Units for Marilog District Barangays | LDRRMF Relief | P 1,500,000.00 |
| TO: 3. Pre-Disaster Administrative Overtime Bonuses and Regular Clerical Salaries | 30% Quick Response Fund | P 9,000,000.00 |
| TOTAL REPROGRAMMED APPROPRIATION | | P 15,000,000.00 |
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Schedule table of reprogrammed appropriations modeled after Ord. No. 0692-21 §2.

sections.sec_title: UTILIZATION OF QUICK RESPONSE FUND FOR REGULAR SALARIES
sections.text: Notwithstanding the absence of a declared State of Calamity, the City Treasurer and the City Budget Officer are hereby authorized to immediately disburse Nine Million Pesos (P9,000,000.00) or sixty percent (60%) of the thirty percent (30%) Quick Response Fund (QRF) standby allocation to pay regular monthly administrative salaries, year-end productivity bonuses, and office furniture purchases for permanent clerical personnel at City Hall, without requiring any Sangguniang Panlungsod resolution declaring a state of calamity.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 10121 §21; Republic Act No. 7160 §324(d)
sections.legal_rationale: Directly contradicts Section 21 of Republic Act No. 10121 and Section 324(d) of Republic Act No. 7160, which strictly restrict the 30% Quick Response Fund (QRF) to a standby fund exclusively for post-disaster relief and recovery programs in areas declared under a State of Calamity by the local sanggunian, and prohibit the diversion of calamity funds to regular personnel services (PS) or administrative bonuses.

sections.text: Subject to the provisions of the preceding section, all disbursements and utilization of funds for emergency evacuation kits and mobile water filtration units shall be governed by existing government budgeting, accounting, and auditing rules and regulations of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), the Commission on Audit (COA), and Republic Act No. 9184, otherwise known as the Government Procurement Reform Act.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Standard fiscal compliance provision modeled after Ord. No. 0692-21 §3.

sections.text: If, for any reason, any section or provision of this Ordinance is declared unconstitutional or invalid, other sections or provisions hereof which are not affected by such declaration shall continue to be in full force and effect. This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
sections.label: Neutral
